title: DONOR CLASS: Committee-to-Candidate Contributions to the 119th Congress, 2023-2024 FEC Cycle
description: Itemized political action committee (PAC) contributions to members of the 119th United States Congress, reconstructed from Federal Election Commission bulk files for the 2023-2024 election cycle. Covers 539 House and Senate members, with contributions classified into eight industry sectors: Defense, Pharma/Health, Finance, Energy, Tech, Foreign Policy, Labor, and Uncategorized. Independent expenditure totals are reported separately and are never summed with direct contributions.
